repository.protocol_execution_copy: copy this byte-identical protocol outside the checkout or into an ignored .sage control root before checking out the execution commit

service.topology: single Ascend NPU; tensor_parallel_size=1; no cross-device collectives
service.structured_output: OpenAI response_format=json_object; strict local proposal_ids parser
service.launch_authority: central-grant holder only; this protocol does not authorize launch

must_bind: exactly one authorized split and its exact run_id
issued_at_utc allocation_start_utc and expires_utc spanning the requested 210-minute allocation, with at least 180 minutes remaining at runner admission
one physical NPU with ID 3 and the frozen topology
base_url port managed_unit container and manager
served_model_name model path config SHA256 and generation-config SHA256
central_grant_contract.development_authorization: development-only grant with one exact fresh run ID
central_grant_contract.heldout_authorization: separate heldout-only grant issued strictly after final development closure; grant binds development closure SHA256 and canonical development raw root
central_grant_contract.heldout_rerun: forbidden unless a fresh central grant carries a nonempty heldout_rerun_authorization_id
central_grant_contract.credentials: API key is supplied only through VLLM_HUST_API_KEY and is never part of request, grant, preflight, row, manifest, or log artifacts

experiment.randomization: all family-seed-repeat units are shuffled once by order_seed; sampling seeds are fixed by repeat

development_heldout_isolation.development_gate_binds: final development closure is created only after runner candidate admission, independent raw verification, recursive raw/control secret scans, scoped cleanup, release request, and central release acknowledgement; it binds all artifact SHA256 values, exact 80-key coverage, protocol/execution/grant, and admission predicates

comparators.primary_baseline: deterministic-proposal-selector over byte-identical semantic-graph H0 and proposal catalog
comparators.diagnostic_upper_envelope: proposal oracle over the prebuilt catalog; ground truth used only for scoring/diagnosis
comparators.permission_labeled_reference: constrained full-evidence global reclustering; never treated as a shared-permission selector peer
comparators.legacy_v1: historical merge/no-op only; excluded from the v2 primary endpoint

statistics.primary_population: 40 held-out family-seed units; five model repeats averaged within unit
statistics.primary_endpoint: mean F1(online model selector) minus mean F1(deterministic shared-catalog selector)
statistics.confidence_interval: two-sided 95% family-clustered nonparametric bootstrap; resample 10 families and retain all seeds/repeats within sampled family
statistics.primary_admission_rule: lower endpoint of family-clustered 95% CI must exceed 0; report result even if it fails
secondary_endpoints: exact-oracle proposal match and proposal precision
statistics.multiplicity: one confirmatory primary endpoint; all secondary endpoints are descriptive

stopping_rules.heldout_efficacy_stopping: none; once heldout starts, finish all 200 planned model rows
immediate_safety_stop: central grant expiry or device mismatch
foreign process or container on granted device
stopping_rules.infrastructure_retry: no row-level retry beyond the client request attempt; a complete rerun needs a fresh raw namespace and documented central reauthorization, never an efficacy-triggered retry

failure_and_rollback.malformed_or_non_json_response: record full raw response/provider envelope without credentials; select empty list; preserve exact H0
failure_and_rollback.unknown_duplicate_or_conflicting_ids: runtime validator rejects whole batch atomically; preserve exact H0 with reason code
failure_and_rollback.request_failure: record exception class and any response body; select empty list; count as request/parser failure
failure_and_rollback.partial_heldout: inadmissible as paper evidence; retain as failed real-online provenance only
failure_and_rollback.partial_any_split: write RUNNING before the first request; atomically update the row ledger after each row; a complete runner output is only PROVISIONAL_COMPLETE; exceptions retain FAILED_PARTIAL. Verifier/cleanup/scan/release failures prevent final closure PASS and therefore can never be paper-admissible
failure_and_rollback.cleanup_on_any_exit: prelaunch requires the fixed unit and container names to be absent; cleanup uses only exact systemctl stop plus exact dedicated-container stop/removal, never broad manage.sh cleanup; verify NPU3, port, unit, and container clear; emit release request through the central single writer

raw_evidence.reason: raw roots contain host paths, repository/submodule commits, model/service/environment provenance, process observations, requests, and raw provider responses
required_per_row: family seed repeat sampling seed and execution order
observable prompt request payload without authorization header
raw response body and provider usage
H0 catalog selection H1 and validator digests/outcomes
required_run_files: all raw rows manifest and fail-closed summary
before/after device process container and port observations
central release acknowledgement stored outside the frozen control inventory
raw_evidence.final_verifier: the raw verifier independently implements and recomputes summaries and family-clustered CI, validates exact 80/200 key sets, timestamps inside the immutable grant window, file/row hashes, catalog/evidence invariants, and provenance. A separate final closure verifier then binds raw-verifier digest, exact control inventory, raw/control scans, cleanup observations, release request, and central release acknowledgement; only its PASS sets paper_admissible=true

anonymized_publication_gate.default: REJECT until an explicit allowlist-only export is produced after the run
reject_patterns: hostnames IP addresses ports service units containers and process IDs
git remotes author emails and repository/submodule commits including 7-40 hex abbreviations
API keys Authorization/Bearer values and environment secrets
unallowlisted raw requests responses logs grants preflight cleanup or release files
anonymized_publication_gate.publication_label: derived-artifact until anonymous artifact verifier separately passes; never silently relabel raw evidence

must_pass_after_central_grant_before_lau: grant binds protocol SHA execution commit NPU3 model service and unexpired TTL
NPU3 has no foreign process and no conflicting container/device owner
port 18383 is free before launch and owned by the exact managed service after launch
repo and required submodules are clean at frozen commits and esage-vllm-hust-dev is active
model config hashes match and /v1/models returns the frozen served name
structured-output smoke returns strict proposal_ids JSON without a benchmark unit
development and heldout output roots do not exist
at least 5 GiB free space and raw-log secret scanner enabled
cleanup trap and central release path are armed
physical_preflight_logic.read_only_pre_request_gate: protocol validator, three SHA-bound review envelopes, frozen queue-base observation, model metadata hashes, source-code hashes, and fresh namespace template only; this is a static-logic PASS and implies no hardware observation or authorization
physical_preflight_logic.authorized_execution_gate: after a central grant only: PASS_PRELAUNCH proves NPU/port idle and the grant-named unit/container absent; PASS postlaunch binds the exact prelaunch file SHA and proves unit/container/NPU plus listening-socket PID lineage, model identity, and a non-benchmark strict proposal_ids smoke; runner rechecks grant expiry, clean commit, unit/container/NPU and socket-owner lineage before every row

steps: validate exact protocol and central grant before any service action
launch only the grant-named repo-owned managed unit/container on NPU3 and port 18383
run exactly one authorized split into its canonical fresh raw root
leave a complete raw run PROVISIONAL_COMPLETE rather than PASS
on every success error or signal use exact systemctl stop and exact dedicated-container stop/removal; never invoke broad manage.sh stop
verify granted NPU, port, unit and container clear and retain cleanup observations

scan every raw and control artifact recursively; scan before copying grant/preflight/protocol; immediately redact and fail closed on exact API-key or credential-header/token material; retain checksum-bearing reports
after cleanup and scans run the independently implemented raw summary/CI/provenance verifier
emit a local handoff that is explicitly not paper-admissible
central single writer records queue release and emits a SHA-bound acknowledgement; protocol owner never edits the queue
run the final closure verifier; only its PASS is paper-admissible
obtain a separate heldout-only grant issued after and bound to final development closure
execution_and_release_chain.legacy_bypass: forbidden: no skip-server-management, skip-NPU-check, arbitrary output-dir, arbitrary base-url, or keep-server exit is exposed by the orchestrator
execution_and_release_chain.failure_semantics: runner failure, independent verifier failure, cleanup failure, any raw/control secret finding, release mismatch, missing/invalid central acknowledgement, or control/raw drift prevents final closure PASS. Historical artifact verification compares recorded request/preflight/row timestamps to the immutable allocation window and does not require the expired grant to remain live

non_substitution.old_v1_online: cannot substitute: different H0, merge/no-op action semantics, and no shared proposal catalog
non_substitution.offline_mock: cannot substitute: no endpoint or model invocation
non_substitution.replay_simulation_derived: cannot be promoted to real-online evidence
non_substitution.same_family_14b_v1: cannot substitute for v2 or establish cross-family robustness
